skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — create a 30-second product video from this description: energetic, modern...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Instantly generate 30-second product videos from text prompts, with no editing skills required.

- Create MP4, MOV, WebM, or AVI videos up to 500MB from a simple text prompt (style, tone, overlays, etc.)
- Automatic cloud GPU processing — videos ready in 1-2 minutes, 1080p by default
- Supports uploading and editing your own footage, audio, or images
- Simple authentication with free token and 100 credits (7-day validity)
- Full video editing workflow: prompt-based editing, file upload, export, and credit balance tracking
- Built-in error handling for upload limits, credits, authentication, and session status
